projections.source: Dubey, SciNets: Graph-Constrained Multi-Hop Reasoning for Scientific Literature Synthesis, arXiv:2601.09727
projections.retained_semantic_object: shortest, diverse-k-shortest and stochastic multi-hop routes expose a depth/diversity versus grounding-stability trade-off; path depth is a discovery coordinate rather than correctness authority
projections.equivalence_mapping: supports RAKL separating BRIDGE navigation/search from witnessed end-to-end transfer and motivates Pareto path selection
projections.cannot_see: behavioral grounding metrics do not establish scientific correctness, typed relation composition or target authority

projections.source: Du et al., CARV: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Compositional Analogical Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs, arXiv:2603.27958
projections.facet: compositional analogy as a distinct evaluation problem
projections.retained_semantic_object: multiple source relations require extracting and composing rules; pairwise analogy competence does not imply compositional analogy competence
projections.equivalence_mapping: supports a dedicated META_N040 benchmark rather than treating pairwise mapping tests as sufficient
projections.cannot_see: visual rule composition does not by itself specify scientific regimes, evidence lineage, mechanism authority or target transfer

projections.source: Lorenz and Tull, Causal and Compositional Abstraction, arXiv:2602.16612
projections.retained_semantic_object: abstractions can be formalized as natural transformations with query/intervention semantics and component-level structure
projections.equivalence_mapping: supports requiring declared map/query semantics before claiming scientific path composition
projections.cannot_see: does not license generic transitivity of arbitrary RAKL similarity relations

projections.source: Rischel and Weichwald, Compositional Abstraction Error and a Category of Causal Models, arXiv:2103.15758
projections.retained_semantic_object: error composition requires an error notion/framework with proven compositional behavior; ordinary divergences such as KL need not obey the naive triangle-style bound needed for generic path addition
projections.equivalence_mapping: directly triggered Round-019 CERTIFIED_ERROR_COMPOSITION_SEMANTICS and a same-round corrective benchmark addendum
projections.cannot_see: their particular causal-model error framework is not imported as a universal error metric for all RAKL analogy relations

projections.source: Ott and Jäkel, Types of Relations: Defining Analogies with Category Theory, arXiv:2505.19792
projections.retained_semantic_object: categories, functors and universal constructions provide formal languages for analogy and structural composition
projections.equivalence_mapping: supports a future relation-specific composition registry while reinforcing that composition depends on relation structure rather than a generic similar-to edge
projections.cannot_see: category-theoretic representability alone does not establish scientific evidence authority or empirical transfer validity

projections.retained_semantic_object: literature concept graphs and structural-hole search can operationalize cross-cluster hypothesis generation with adversarial evidence gathering
projections.equivalence_mapping: open-source implementation reference for candidate bridge search, not for RAKL transfer authority
projections.cannot_see: does not implement RAKL typed handoffs, invariant continuity, certified error composition or endpoint no-escalation

novelty_boundary: RAKL does not claim invention of multi-hop graph synthesis, compositional analogy, category-theoretic analogy, causal abstraction composition or compositional error bounds. The retained candidate contribution is an evidence-governed bridge certificate that separates navigability from transfer composability and refuses endpoint-relation or target-authority escalation.
